dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast white perimeters with sharp gradient transitions into dark interiors, most clearly defined in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily along the neck and the anterior-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central dorsal field form an obtuse scalene triangle, while two smaller anterior blobs form a near-parallel line with the dorsal silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, high-intensity punctate marks form a distinct linear chain along the posterior-lateral margin near the flipper attachment.
